title: AFlow: Automating Agentic Workflow Generation
authors: Jiayi Zhang; Jinyu Xiang; Zhaoyang Yu; Fengwei Teng; Xiong-Hui Chen; Jiaqi Chen; Mingchen Zhuge; Xin Cheng; Sirui Hong; Jinlin Wang; Bingnan Zheng; Bang Liu; et al.

problem_statement.en: Building effective agentic workflows (structured sequences of LLM invocations with control logic) still requires heavy manual design, and prior automation methods rely on manual initial setup and search over overly narrow representations, so they fail to fully automate discovery of effective, diverse workflows. The goal is to automatically generate optimized workflows per task/domain with minimal human intervention.
problem_statement.zh: 建構有效的 agentic workflow(具控制邏輯的結構化 LLM 呼叫序列)仍需大量人工設計,而既有的自動化方法依賴人工初始設定,並在過度狹隘的表示空間中搜尋,因而無法完全自動化地探索出有效且多樣的 workflow。其目標在於以最少的人為介入,針對各任務/領域自動生成經最佳化的 workflow。

key_innovation.en: Reformulates workflow optimization as a search over code-represented workflows (LLM-invoking nodes connected by code edges, plus reusable Operators) navigated by a Monte Carlo Tree Search variant, where an LLM acts as optimizer to expand/revise workflow code and execution accuracy is the reward, with a soft mixed-probability node-selection rule and tree-structured experience backpropagation.
key_innovation.zh: 將 workflow 最佳化重新表述為對「以程式碼表示的 workflow」之搜尋(由呼叫 LLM 的節點透過程式碼邊連接,並輔以可重用的 Operators),以一種 Monte Carlo Tree Search(MCTS)變體導航;其中 LLM 扮演 optimizer 的角色,用以擴展或修訂 workflow 程式碼,並以執行準確率作為獎勵,同時採用軟性混合機率的節點選擇規則與樹狀結構的經驗反向傳播。

baselines_compared: IO, Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency CoT, MultiPersona Debate, Self-Refine, MedPrompt, ADAS

key_improvements.en: On six benchmarks with a GPT-4o-mini executor (Table 1, avg of 3 runs), AFlow reaches 80.3 average vs best baselines CoT SC 76.0, MedPrompt 75.3, MultiPersona 75.1, CoT 74.7, IO 72.8, Self-Refine 70.7, and automated-method ADAS 67.2 — a 5.7% average improvement over manually designed methods and 19.5% over existing automated workflow optimization. Per-dataset AFlow: HotpotQA 73.5, DROP 80.6, HumanEval 94.7, MBPP 83.4, GSM8K 93.5, MATH 56.2. Improves over ADAS on MATH(lv5*) and MBPP by 57%.
key_improvements.zh: 在六個 benchmark 上、使用 GPT-4o-mini 作為 executor(Table 1,3 次執行平均),AFlow 達到 80.3 的平均分,優於最佳 baseline:CoT SC 76.0、MedPrompt 75.3、MultiPersona 75.1、CoT 74.7、IO 72.8、Self-Refine 70.7,以及自動化方法 ADAS 67.2,相較人工設計方法平均提升 5.7%,相較既有自動化 workflow 最佳化提升 19.5%。各資料集 AFlow 表現為:HotpotQA 73.5、DROP 80.6、HumanEval 94.7、MBPP 83.4、GSM8K 93.5、MATH 56.2。在 MATH(lv5*)與 MBPP 上較 ADAS 提升 57%。成本方面:AFlow 所發現的 workflow 使較小的模型在特定任務上以 GPT-4o 推論成本(以美元計)的 4.55% 即超越 GPT-4o。消融實驗(GSM8K)顯示:即使不使用預先定義的 operators,AFlow 仍達到 93.1%,超越人工設計方案。

structure_space: Workflow code, Operator / node graph, Prompts (joint)
decision_mechanism: MCTS / tree search, Textual gradient (LLM feedback)
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Validation-set score, Textual feedback
benchmarks_used: GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP, HotpotQA, DROP

agent_scenario.en: One LLM optimizer (Claude-3.5-sonnet) searches, offline, over code-represented workflows executed by a single executor LLM (GPT-4o-mini in the main table; also DeepSeek-V2.5, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-sonnet in Table 2). A workflow is a DAG-like sequence of LLM-invoking nodes wired by edge code, built from operators (Generate, Format, Review & Revise, Ensemble, Test, Programmer, Custom); Figure 2 further depicts operator structures such as Self-Consistency Ensemble, Multi-Agent Debate, and Self-Refine. It is a single-domain, offline workflow-generation setting (per benchmark: QA, code generation, math) rather than a live multi-agent runtime; the searched workflow may itself embed multi-agent/test-time-scaling operators. Protocol detail: each candidate workflow is executed 5x on validation for a robust reward, and experience (modification + outcome logs) is backpropagated up the MCTS tree.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一 LLM optimizer(Claude-3.5-sonnet)以離線方式,對由單一 executor LLM(主表中為 GPT-4o-mini;Table 2 另含 DeepSeek-V2.5、GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-sonnet)所執行、以程式碼表示的 workflow 進行搜尋。一個 workflow 為由邊程式碼串接、呼叫 LLM 之節點所構成的類 DAG 序列,並由 operators(Generate、Format、Review & Revise、Ensemble、Test、Programmer、Custom)組建;Figure 2 進一步描繪如 Self-Consistency Ensemble、Multi-Agent Debate 與 Self-Refine 等 operator 結構。此為單一領域、離線的 workflow 生成情境(依 benchmark 分為:QA、程式碼生成、數學),而非即時運行的 multi-agent runtime;所搜尋出的 workflow 本身則可能內嵌 multi-agent/test-time-scaling operator。協定細節:每個候選 workflow 於驗證集上執行 5 次以取得穩健的獎勵,並將經驗(修改與結果日誌)沿 MCTS 樹反向傳播。
